name: EntityPool
description: Generic, declarative object pool. Each pooled entity's component set is declared as data (resolved by name via the SceneLoader), so spawning a wave never churns entities or meshes. `entityPool.spawn` un-parks and resets a slot (re-applying config, clearing transient tags, positioning the MeshPrimitive collision proxy) and emits `entityPool.spawned` / `entityPool.acquired`; `entityPool.release` parks it and emits `entityPool.released`. Also emits `entityPool.ready` once each pool is pre-allocated and `entityPool.exhausted` when every slot is live.
